scope: Read-only browser/CLI integration and presenter trace/owner review; no build, test, renderer, desktop or GPU execution by reviewer

findings.initial_issue: Check skipped report extraction, and measure caught extraction refusal then still serialized; stalled-owner shutdown could emit JSON before positive release.
findings.resolution: Both report modes first require benchmark_owner_released; only Phase::Released qualifies. Unresolved owner returns failure without stdout JSON. Existing failure remains primary.

findings.initial_issue: Check-only acquire returning None retired with verified=0, cleared the deadline and left the browser pending without completion/error/wake.
findings.resolution: After safe packet retirement and accounting reset, an armed selected check with zero verification fails, receives a release deadline and wakes the UI once. No retry or false verified/completion record.

other_reviewed_conclusions: Exact scene bytes, target epochs, scale factor, edit acknowledgement and queued transport are checked before each timed preparation and again at completion; UI/page changes after arming fail.
Benchmark-only fixed status applies to both routes; unused real load time remains metadata.
Check verification remains disarmed through startup; selected serial/route and safe idle are required for checked proof.
Timed samples require one outstanding exact ID/stamp; nonpresented/failed work cannot advance the successful sample count.
Identity/serialization and scene diagnostics remain outside measured preparation; default/check-only paths do not evaluate optional timing clocks.
Timed pending data cannot be replaced by an untimed/new timed packet; CPU fallback cannot count as the native route.
Native partial encoders remain discarded; MayHaveWrites still flushes exactly once, retirement and reverse error scopes run before outcome propagation; explicit destruction only follows completion.
Packet drop precedes idle and completion publication. Late deadline/scope failures remain terminal and retain failed/incomplete evidence.
Timing report extraction requires actual Released state and moves samples without cloning; check result can retain proven checked=true alongside a later overall failure.
CLI rejects native measurement with verification/check/headless/other benchmark modes and screenshots before startup; ordinary configuration remains unchanged.
limitations: Static review only; no execution result is asserted.
CPU cleanup_ns is absent, not invented zero; durations are host wall-clock brackets, not GPU timestamps or display latency.
Canonical paint inputs are not an independent pixel oracle; separate correctness runs remain required.
